title: Evaluating the Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation to Adversarial Evidence in the Health Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Creating skewed retrieval pools (bias-controlled pooling) that are disproportionately filled with either helpful or harmful/adversarial health misinformation documents to evaluate how imbalanced evidence presentation affects the factual alignment of LLM responses.

Evaluating LLM outputs against user queries structured with different presuppositions (consistent, neutral, and inconsistent with the ground truth) to measure how the implicit tone and framing of a prompt bias the model's interpretation and factual agreement.
